creators.name: 秋風 (Aki Kaze) / 秋 譲治 (Aki Jorge)

title: 4D Invariant Matrix Cosmology
description: A conceptual model for a new integrated cosmology (the Entropy Wave Hypothesis) that provides a unified solution to the unsolved problems of modern physics through a single wave model of entropy-equalizing motion within [4-dimensional invariant matrix space.]
notes: ※ 本ドキュメントはアイデアの未検証のたたき台であり、統合理論に向けた概念モデルです。(This document is an unverified draft of ideas and a conceptual model toward an integrated theory.)
